heading: Wednesday, December 17, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Google Gemini 3 Flash and Mistral AI Mistral OCR 3.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 3 Flash
items.summary: Gemini 3 Flash is designed to pair Gemini 3 Pro-grade reasoning with Flash-level latency and cost. Google reports 90.4% on GPQA Diamond and 78% on SWE-bench Verified. It became the default model in the Gemini app and is priced at $0.50/$3 per million input/output tokens.

image.alt: LMArena Elo versus price per million tokens, with Gemini 3 Flash on the Pareto frontier

items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral OCR 3
items.summary: Mistral OCR 3 is a document-extraction model that outputs Markdown with HTML table reconstruction, priced at $2 per 1,000 pages. Mistral reports a 74% overall win rate over OCR 2 on forms, scans, complex tables and handwriting in internal tests.
